cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Don’t Question the Premise
cards.instruction: Redirect every attempt to ask why the strange situation exists toward what must happen next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. The ghost's waiting at our breakfast table. Do we have cereal?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why is it haunting our kitchen? We're already late.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then give it the instant porridge. I'll find a bowl.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why would a dead person need feeding? I'm taking the car.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll put it in a travel cup. You can drop it at the cemetery on your way.

mechanism: A corrects a partner's explanatory questions into breakfast and transport logistics for a ghost, prioritizing next action.
confusable: D157 conceals A's own cause; D158 needs no guilt, only systematic redirection of why questions into practical next steps.
comparison: A late household departure differs from gallery flood containment.
seedUse: Keep lateness and car as usable B contributions, and remove ambiguous it between ghost and porridge.
